reserve_profile.summary: Blast documentation historically described USDB as issued when users bridge stablecoins, linked to DAI and protocol reserve income. Blast's October 2026 wind-down materially changes the operating context: the network is unwinding yield infrastructure and directing users to exit to Ethereum. This remains a protocol backing description, not an issuer reserve attestation.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Users able to access and operate the Blast withdrawal/bridge flow or, after the normal interface is withdrawn, interact directly with the Blast bridge contracts on Ethereum L1.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Not established in the reviewed public source set.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Bridge and network fees may apply; exact current terms require live bridge review.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Blast announced a temporary withdrawal interruption while Lido-linked assets are unwound, followed by a 24-hour withdrawal delay. Normal interface withdrawals are planned through 2026-10-26; direct L1 bridge-contract withdrawal is described for afterward.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Protocol and interface access conditions apply.
DAI bridge redemption is not direct fiat redemption.
The October 26 interface deadline is not treated as a final asset-recovery deadline.
